title: FHFA House Price Index — monthly index (May 2027), 9:00 a.m. ET
source: EST: the same two FHFA primaries this proposer read in full on 2026-09-08 for its own date, parsed row by row rather than inherited from a sibling. (1) fhfa.gov/data/hpi (HTTP 200, 89,663 bytes) -- its 2027 HPI Release Dates table, twelve dated rows Jan 26 -> Dec 28. (2) The published 2026Q2 report (HTTP 200, 1,522,949 bytes, released 2026-08-25; 517 stream objects located, 511 inflated in-session with node zlib), whose 'FHFA HPI Release Dates for 2027' appendix page carries the identical twelve rows above the statement 'Public FHFA HPI(R) releases occur at 9AM ET and include a press release, tables, figures, and associated data' -- the source of the 9:00 a.m. ET time. All twelve 2027 rows were checked against rule-derived last Tuesdays and all twelve match. Filed estimate because a proposal is always estimate by contract and because this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep; promote on an independent second look by whichever lane takes this id, exactly as this proposer did for its own. The row for this id reads verbatim 'Tuesday, July 27 | Monthly Index | May 2027', the seventh of the twelve. THE EDITION TYPE IS QUOTED RATHER THAN ASSUMED: the same table marks exactly four 2027 rows quarterly -- February 23, May 25, August 31 and November 30 -- so this is a monthly edition by the publisher own labelling. notes: DISCOVERED during the fhfa-hpi-2027-11-30 initial research (2026-09-08). All five are proposed in the same PR, which closes the 2027 FHFA calendar: every row of the publisher's own posted table is now tracked. THREE THINGS FOR WHOEVER TAKES THIS ID. (1) BLACKOUT MEMBERSHIP IS ALREADY DERIVED AND IT IS YES. This session parsed all 56 posted FOMC meeting pairs 2021-2027 from federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm (HTTP 200, 164,831 bytes, 'Last Update: August 19, 2026') and derived each blackout from the Board's own rule. This date sits INSIDE the window 2027-07-17 -> 2027-07-29, and 2027-07-27 is FOMC DAY ONE of the July 27-28 meeting. The proposer's own Leg 3 measured that a blackout is a real volatility regime (all blackout vs clear sessions, VIX9D/VIX 0.9884 vs 0.9065, p=0.0000, n=405 vs 1,020) and that its signature differs by which meeting it precedes -- so control on blackout membership before believing any tape reading on this date, and do not import another month's control. Re-derive rather than trusting this note; the Board calls every 2027 date tentative until the meeting immediately preceding it confirms it. (2) THE SEASONAL HYPOTHESIS IS CLOSED -- DO NOT RE-OPEN IT. Seven reference months have now been tested and refuted across this chain, and the fhfa-hpi-2027-08-31 ledger carries the full twelve-month table in which not one month separates at any conventional threshold. A further refutation is a confirmation of a closed hypothesis, not a finding. (3) THE INTERESTING CONTENT QUESTION IS THE RESTATEMENT, AND ITS BASE RATES ARE ALREADY MEASURED. The fhfa-hpi-2027-11-30 ledger's Leg 5 harvested 49 report vintages (2022-06-28 -> 2026-08-25, 245 U.S.-column revision observations): median absolute first restatement 0.10pp, mean 0.061pp, max 0.20pp, 21 of 49 unchanged, ZERO sign flips in 49, and quarterly versus monthly editions indistinguishable at p=1.0000. FHFA prints the m/m to one decimal, so 0.1pp is the measurement quantum.
